Morrowmark: model-translated Spanish dictionary senses and source-explicit forms

Original Spanish dictionary material: Wiktionary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Extracted by Wiktextract / Kaikki; Tatu Ylonen, Wiktextract: Wiktionary as
Machine-Readable Structured Data, LREC 2022, pp. 1317–1325.
https://kaikki.org/dictionary/rawdata.html
https://kaikki.org/dictionary/downloads/es/es-extract.jsonl.gz
Pinned artifact SHA256:
f348077dec293b11c2dc3e13cf20d25d44403b519369b382e33f0aef7792b1ad
The included full CC BY-SA 4.0 terms apply to the retained/modified dictionary
material. Source entry links, raw record hashes and selected senses remain in
the per-word audit. The bulk artifact supplies no exact per-entry revision ID.

Changes: freeze a reviewed lexical selection, retain its Spanish source senses
and explicit grammatical descriptions, omit quotations/examples/media, translate
selected meanings into English using two independent model reviews, and render
only supported source morphology. English text is our model translation, NOT a
source-provided English quotation or a human/native-certified Mexican example.
The grammatical English snippets are selected readings, not complete sentences,
all senses, or all contexts. Source errors and coverage gaps remain possible.
No example sentences or translated examples are fabricated for these words.

English inflection data: AGID 2016.01.19, separately permissive contributor
terms retained in the repository's AGID notices. Its location alongside the
Apertium sources does not make this generator a user of the GPL bilingual
lexicon: this layer reads only the independently licensed AGID inflections.
The separate Apertium-derived layer retains its own GPL v2 provenance/notices.

Replay lexical/form evidence from the exact cached artifact with
scripts/import-spanish-derived-evidence.py ARCHIVE --check. Reproduce compiled
meanings offline with scripts/generate-spanish-derived-translations.py --check.
See src/data/spanish/spanish-derived-source.json and WORDS-LICENSE.md.
The ordinary game answer/guess pools and saved rounds are not changed by this
translation layer. Local translation lookup calls no translation service.
